title: API Rate Limits and Technical Specifications
summary: This document specifies an integration quota of $100,000 API calls per month and recommends monitoring consumption. It covers real-time behavior (Balance updates: Yes), and provides technical guidance: cache reference data, request deltas, use exponential backoff + idempotency for retries, and proactively throttle while instrumenting success/error/retry metrics.
faqs: What is my monthly API call allocation limit for this integration?
Does the API support real-time balance updates, and how should I sync to reduce calls?
How should I design polling/sync to respect the monthly call allocation (e.g., deltas vs full data)?
What retry strategy should I use (e.g., backoff and idempotency) to avoid duplicate transactions and wasted calls?
How can I monitor usage and technical health to prevent hitting the call limit?
What observability metrics should I instrument in my integration (successes, errors, retries)?
